event.elsewhere.description: When an event starts or ends (in the column beside the timeline, the list of events, an event's page), when the event's time zone is not the reader's: its date and time in the reader's zone ({here}), then its time in the event's own zone ({there}, with the weekday when the day there is another) with the zone's place name ({zone}, such as Tokyo).

event.by.description: Who organizes an event, in its line of a list (the events' screen, a profile): name is the organizer's display name.

event.by.unavailable.description: Who organizes an event, in its line of a list (the events' screen, a profile), when the organizer is an account the reader may not see (suspended, deactivated, hidden by the moderators, or blocking the reader); event.by otherwise.

event.going.description: How many answered going to an event, for assistive technology beside the people glyph and the figure, in its line of a list and on its page.

event.went.description: How many answered going to an event that ended, for assistive technology beside the people glyph and the figure.

event.date_polled.description: In place of an event's time in its line of a list, while its organizers poll its date.

event.state.description: Marks an event in its line of a list and on its page: it was cancelled, or it ended.

event.place_kind.defaultMessage: {kind, select, voice {Chat de voz} physical {Presencial} other {Online}}
event.place_kind.description: The kind of a place of an event, beside its glyph in the event's line of a list: a voice chat room, a place to meet in person, or a URL online.
